update.comment: Remove unused Iteration and Timestep columns from LandscapeRasters

action.item: CREATE TABLE temp_table AS SELECT * FROM burnP3Plus_LandscapeRasters

CREATE TABLE burnP3Plus_LandscapeRasters ( LandscapeRastersID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ScenarioID INTEGER, FuelGridFileName TEXT, ElevationGridFileName TEXT, FireZoneGridFileName TEXT, WeatherZoneGridFileName TEXT, Band INTEGER)

INSERT INTO burnP3Plus_LandscapeRasters ( LandscapeRastersID, ScenarioID, FuelGridFileName, ElevationGridFileName, FireZoneGridFileName, WeatherZoneGridFileName, Band) SELECT LandscapeRastersID, ScenarioID, FuelGridFileName, ElevationGridFileName, FireZoneGridFileName, WeatherZoneGridFileName, Band FROM temp_table
